verses.text: A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the one directing. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O YHWH, God of my salvation, [by] day I have cried out, [and] in the night before You.

segments.text: A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the one directing. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O YHWH, God of my salvation, [by] day I have cried out, [and] in the night before You.

verses.text: May my prayer come before Your face; incline Your ear to my cry!

segments.text: May my prayer come before Your face; incline Your ear to my cry!

verses.text: For my soul is filled with troubles, and my life has reached to Sheol.

segments.text: For my soul is filled with troubles, and my life has reached to Sheol.

verses.text: I am counted with those going down into the Pit; I am like a man with no strength,

segments.text: I am counted with those going down into the Pit; I am like a man with no strength,

verses.text: among the dead [set] free, like the slain lying down in the grave, whom You do not remember anymore, even they [who] are cut off from Your hand.

segments.text: among the dead [set] free, like the slain lying down in the grave, whom You do not remember anymore, even they [who] are cut off from Your hand.

verses.text: You have set me in the lowest Pit, in darkness in the depths.

segments.text: You have set me in the lowest Pit, in darkness in the depths.

verses.text: Upon me Your wrath has grabbed hold, and [with] all Your waves You have afflicted. Selah

segments.text: Upon me Your wrath has grabbed hold, and [with] all Your waves You have afflicted. Selah

verses.text: You have put my acquaintances far from me; You have made me loathsome to them; [I am] shut in, and I cannot go forth.

segments.text: You have put my acquaintances far from me; You have made me loathsome to them; [I am] shut in, and I cannot go forth.

verses.text: My eye languishes from [this] affliction; I have called to You, O YHWH, all the day; I have stretched out to You my hands.

segments.text: My eye languishes from [this] affliction; I have called to You, O YHWH, all the day; I have stretched out to You my hands.

verses.text: Will You work wonders for the dead? And if departed spirits rise up, do they thank You? Selah

segments.text: Will You work wonders for the dead? And if departed spirits rise up, do they thank You? Selah

verses.text: Can Your loving devotion be recounted in the Grave, [or] Your faithfulness in Abaddon?

segments.text: Can Your loving devotion be recounted in the Grave, [or] Your faithfulness in Abaddon?

verses.text: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

segments.text: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.text: And I, O YHWH, cry for help to You, and in the morning my prayer comes before You.

segments.text: And I, O YHWH, cry for help to You, and in the morning my prayer comes before You.

verses.text: Why, O YHWH, do You reject my soul? You hide Your face from me.

segments.text: Why, O YHWH, do You reject my soul? You hide Your face from me.

verses.text: I [am] afflicted and dying from my youth; I bear Your terrors; I am in despair.

segments.text: I [am] afflicted and dying from my youth; I bear Your terrors; I am in despair.

verses.text: Your wrath has passed over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

segments.text: Your wrath has passed over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

verses.text: They came around me like the waters all the day, they surrounded me altogether.

segments.text: They came around me like the waters all the day, they surrounded me altogether.

verses.text: You have put far my beloved and friend; my close acquaintance [is] darkness.
